messages:
sophia: Running a 6h soak in staging targeting per-key and per-org quotas. early signal: large spike of quota rejects that looks like double-counting across keys. anyone else see this?
adam: saw it. pattern: when we ramped zipfian keys-per-org > 1k, quota_rejects jumped nonlinearly. :thinking:
kevin: can you paste the load command you used?
sophia: ```
hammer-swarm --concurrency 800 --pattern zipfian --duration 6h \n  --keys-per-org 2000 --org 0x7f --rate 12000/s 
```
kevin: thanks. quick glance at enforcement logs shows repeated increments to org counters for requests that should be attributed to key shards. looks like the accumulator is updating org and key buckets separately then summing at enforcement, but shard mapping occasionally resolves to both shards for the same trace id.
adam: i captured a small log snippet: ```
[2026-02-14T22:13:01Z] trace=tx-9c1 quota_inc org=0x7f shard=17 key=k-112 delta=1
[2026-02-14T22:13:01Z] trace=tx-9c1 quota_inc org=0x7f shard=3  key=k-112 delta=1
[2026-02-14T22:13:01Z] result=reject reason=quota_exceeded org=0x7f
```
adam: both increments for same request. looks like shard resolution race on retry path. :grimacing:
sophia: that explains the nonlinearity — duplicates inflate org-level usage. do we have metrics for duplicate shard writes?
kevin: not explicitly. telemetry has `quota_inc_total` and `quota_rejects`, but no `quota_shard_mismatch` or `quota_inc_deduplicated` counters.
elaine: this matters for product: customers will see spiky rejects even though their per-key usage is fine. we should patch quickly and communicate.
adam: quick mitigation: disable the aggressive multi-shard write optimization (it trades durability for write-parallelism) via feature flag `rl.v2.multi_shard_write=false` in staging and rerun.
sophia: toggled the flag in staging console a few minutes ago. re-running hammer-swarm now. will update telemetry dashboards. :white_check_mark:
ratebot: deploybot: feature-flag update applied to staging cluster-3 by sophia at 2026-02-14T22:25:12Z
kevin: long-term fix: make shard resolution idempotent at the request boundary — attach a deterministic shard token derived from trace id so duplicate retries map to same shard. also add a dedupe layer in accumulator with small LRU.
adam: agree. also we should add a Prometheus metric `quota_shard_mismatch_total` and an alert when mismatch_rate > 0.1% of quota_inc_total in a minute.
sophia: and update dashboards: enforcement latency (p50/p95), quota_inc_by_shard, quota_rejects_by_org, and a small heatmap for keys-per-org vs throttle-rate.
elaine: communication: we should tell a couple of affected beta customers that we saw spurious rejects in staging and are rolling a fix there; not a production incident but worth a heads-up for customers doing heavy multi-key workloads.
kevin: rollout plan for prod: (1) add metric + dedupe patch in canary (2) enable controlled multi-org canary with rl.v2.multi_shard_write=false fallback (3) 24h soak on canary, watch mismatch metric and throttle p95 (4) flip global when stable.
adam: i'll create a follow-up ticket and a short runbook for oncall -> rollback steps if we see production regressions. also add a temporary dashboard tile for mismatch during the canary.
sophia: results from current rerun: initial 30m looks cleaner, quota_rejects down ~92% vs previous run, mismatch metric is near zero. saving run artifacts now to staging-buckets/soak/1761234567.
kevin: great. can you attach a link to the run artifacts + sample traces? i want to verify dedupe behavior end-to-end.
sophia: link: https://staging-artifacts.internal/redwood/soak/1761234567/index.html (contains hammer logs, enforcement logs, grafana snapshots)
adam: note for telemetry: add p95 enforcement latency by enforcement-path (cache vs db vs fallback) — i saw a small latency bump during the initial ramp that may have amplified retries.
sophia: filed infra-4792 (add metrics + runbook) and infra-4793 (dedupe + deterministic shard token). assigning to kevin and adam respectively.
elaine: thanks team. once fixes land we'll schedule a brief customer note draft. :thumbsup:
kevin: will open PR for dedupe tonight, include unit tests for trace-id determinism.
adam: i'll wire the prometheus metrics and dashboard tiles tomorrow morning.
sophia: closing loop here: staging soak re-run complete, looks good. will re-run a 24h soak next week with different keys-per-org distributions (uniform, heavy-tail, bursty) to be sure.
ratebot: soak-run-bot: next scheduled soak (24h) queued for 2026-02-20T02:00:00Z (assigned to sophia)
